text: DIAGNOSIS READY: 17-alpha-hydroxylase deficiency. The combination of virilization (clitoromegaly, acne), delayed menarche due to lack of estrogen, and hypertension or hypokalemia (which your normal bone density helps rule out as the primary cause of fractures) points to a defect in steroidogenesis where the body converts precursors to mineralocorticoids instead of sex hormones. The normal 17-OHP level is consistent with a deficiency at the 17-alpha-hydroxylase step rather than 21-hydroxylase deficiency.
